title: Places and Directions
ringkas: Tempat umum, kalimat perintah, dan memberi petunjuk arah
goals: menyebut tempat umum di kota: [[post office]], [[bank]], [[hospital]], [[market]], dan lainnya
bertanya letak tempat: [[Where is ...?]] dan [[Is there a ... near here?]]
memahami dan memberi petunjuk arah: [[go straight]], [[turn left]], [[turn right]]
memakai kalimat perintah dan [[Don't ...]] untuk rambu dan aturan
menggunakan preposisi tempat: [[opposite]], [[at the corner]], [[between]], [[next to]]

lesson.text: Pernahkah kamu tersesat atau ditanya jalan oleh turis? Di **Unit 9** kamu belajar menyebut **tempat-tempat di kota** serta **menanyakan dan memberi petunjuk arah** dalam bahasa Inggris. Ini keterampilan yang sangat berguna!

We meet at the train station.
The police station is on Jalan Merdeka.
The mosque is next to the park.
The church is on the corner.
I buy books at the bookstore.
We visit the museum on Saturday.

lesson.title: 2. Bertanya letak tempat
lesson.text: Gunakan salah satu dari pola ini. Awali dengan **Excuse me** supaya sopan.
table: [[Is there a post office near here?]]
Apakah ada kantor pos di dekat sini?
[[How do I get to the hospital?]]
[[Can you tell me the way to the station?]]
Bisakah kamu menunjukkan jalan ke stasiun?

lesson.title: 3. Petunjuk arah (Directions)
table: [[Take the first street on the left.]]
Ambil jalan pertama di sebelah kiri.
[[It's on your left / on your right.]]

lesson.title: Left dan right
lesson.text: **Left** = kiri dan **right** = kanan. Hati-hati, **right** juga berarti "benar". Dengarkan konteksnya: [[Turn right.]] (belok kanan) dan [[That's right.]] (itu benar).

lesson.title: 4. Menjelaskan letak dengan preposisi
lesson.text: Tambahan preposisi dari Unit 5 untuk menjelaskan letak sebuah tempat:
table: [[The market is next to the mosque.]]
[[The pharmacy is between the bank and the bookstore.]]
[[The post office is on the corner.]]
[[The bus stop is in front of the school.]]

lesson.title: 5. Kalimat perintah dan larangan
lesson.text: Untuk memberi arah, kita memakai **kalimat perintah** (kata kerja dasar, tanpa subjek). Untuk **melarang**, pakai **Don't + kata kerja dasar**. Perintah ini juga muncul di rambu-rambu.

lesson.title: 6. on, in, at untuk letak, jalan, dan kendaraan
lesson.text: Saat menjelaskan letak dan perjalanan, pilihan on, in, at ikut aturan berikut:
table: **on** the left / on the right / on Jalan Merdeka
**at** the corner / at the traffic light / at the bus stop
**in** the middle / in the city / in the park
[[The market is in the middle of the town.]]
**on** a bus / on a train / on a plane / on a bike
[[I go to school by bus.]] / [[We go on foot.]]

examples.en: [[Turn left at the corner. The post office is on your right.]]
examples.id: Belok kiri di tikungan. Kantor pos ada di sebelah kananmu.

examples.en: [[I go to school by bike, but my sister goes on foot.]]
examples.id: Aku ke sekolah naik sepeda, tetapi kakakku berjalan kaki.

lesson.title: by bus atau on the bus?
lesson.text: **by bus / by car / by train** dipakai untuk cara bepergian, tanpa a atau the: [[I go by bus.]] Untuk posisi kita memakai **on the bus** atau **in the car**: [[I am on the bus.]] Dan katakan **on foot**, bukan ~~by foot~~.

lesson.title: 7. the dan tanpa the untuk tempat
lesson.text: Tempat umum di kota biasanya memakai **the** karena yang dimaksud tempat tertentu. Tetapi beberapa tempat tidak memakai the jika yang disebut adalah **kegiatannya**.
table: [[The bank is next to the post office.]]
Bank dan kantor pos yang dimaksud jelas
[[I go to the school to meet the principal.]]
[[She is at home.]] / [[He is in hospital.]]
di rumah / sedang dirawat (in hospital: Inggris Britania; Amerika: in the hospital)

examples.en: [[My mother is at home. My father is at the market.]]
examples.id: Ibuku di rumah. Ayahku di pasar.

lines.en: Excuse me. Is there a post office near here?
lines.id: Permisi. Apakah ada kantor pos di dekat sini?

lines.en: Yes, there is. Go straight on this street.
lines.id: Ya, ada. Jalan lurus di jalan ini.

lines.id: Belok kiri di lampu lalu lintas. Kantor posnya ada di sebelah kananmu, di seberang taman.

lines.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?
lines.id: Permisi, bagaimana cara ke stasiun kereta?

lines.en: It's not far. Walk two blocks and turn right.
lines.id: Tidak jauh. Jalan dua blok lalu belok kanan.

lines.en: Is it next to the market?
Yes, it is. It's about three hundred meters from here.
lines.id: Ya. Jaraknya sekitar tiga ratus meter dari sini.

items: Bertanya: [[Excuse me, where is ...?]], [[Is there a ... near here?]], [[How do I get to ...?]]
Arah: [[go straight]], [[turn left]], [[turn right]], [[cross the street]], [[go past ...]].
Letak: [[opposite]], [[next to]], [[between]], [[on the corner]], [[in front of]], [[behind]].
Perintah = kata kerja dasar. Larangan = [[Don't + kata kerja dasar]].
Selalu sopan: awali dengan [[Excuse me]] dan akhiri dengan [[Thank you]].

Tourist: Excuse me, where is the library? Dina: It is near here. Go straight on this street for two blocks. Turn left at the bank. The library is on your right, next to the park.

read.id:
Turis: Permisi, Anda mau ke mana? Dina: Saya mau ke kantor pos. Letaknya dekat taman. Apakah Anda juga mencari suatu tempat? Turis: Ya, saya mencari stasiun bus. Apakah jauh?
Dina: Tidak. Saya berjalan ke arah itu, jadi mari kita pergi bersama. Jalan lurus, lalu belok kanan di bank. Jangan menyeberang jalan di sini, karena ramai. Pakailah zebra cross. Stasiun ada di sebelah kirimu.

read.text:
Tourist: Excuse me, where are you going? Dina: I'm going to the post office. It's near the park. Are you looking for a place too? Tourist: Yes, I'm looking for the bus station. Is it far?
Dina: No, it isn't. I'm walking that way, so let's go together. Go straight, and then turn right at the bank. Don't cross the road here, because it is busy. Use the zebra crossing. The station is on your left.
read.title: Where Are You Going?

Budi: Halo, Dina. Aku di terminal bus. Bagaimana caraku sampai ke rumahmu? Dina: Mudah. Seberangi jalan dan berjalan melewati bank. Belok kiri di lampu lalu lintas. Budi: Apakah aku lurus setelah itu?
Dina: Ya. Berjalanlah dua blok, dan kamu akan melihat rumah putih. Letaknya di sebelah kantor pos. Jangan belok kanan di pasar, karena jalan itu panjang. Budi: Baik. Aku akan sampai dalam sepuluh menit.

read.text:
Budi: Hello, Dina. I'm at the bus station. How do I get to your house? Dina: It's easy. Cross the road and walk past the bank. Turn left at the traffic light. Budi: Do I go straight after that?
Dina: Yes, you do. Walk for two blocks, and you see a white house. It is next to the post office. Don't turn right at the market, because that road is long. Budi: Okay. I'll be there in ten minutes.
read.title: Giving Directions on the Phone

read.focus: Preposisi arah dan kendaraan: on, at, by, to, into
read.id:
Turis: Permisi, bagaimana saya ke museum? Budi: Jalan menyusuri jalan ini dan belok kiri di tikungan. Museum ada di sebelah kananmu, di samping bank. Turis: Apakah jauh? Budi: Tidak juga. Kamu bisa berjalan kaki, atau naik bus.
Turis: Bus mana yang menuju museum? Budi: Naik nomor 12 dan turun di perhentian kedua. Kamu bisa menunggu di halte di depan toko itu. Turis: Terima kasih! Budi: Hati-hati saat kamu masuk ke stasiun. Ramai sekali.

qs.exp: Budi: "The museum is on your right, next to the bank."
options: On the right, next to the bank
On the left, behind the shop
At the corner, in front of the bus stop
Get off at the second stop.

qs.q: Choose the correct word: "Wait ___ the bus stop."

qs.id: Lengkapi dengan on, by, atau at:
Lengkapi dengan at, on, atau in:

qs.answer: Get off at the second stop.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Turunlah di perhentian kedua."

read.text:
Tourist: Excuse me, how do I get to the museum? Budi: Go along this street and turn left at the corner. The museum is on your right, next to the bank. Tourist: Is it far? Budi: Not really. You can go on foot, or by bus.
Tourist: Which bus goes to the museum? Budi: Take number 12 and get off at the second stop. You can wait at the bus stop in front of that shop. Tourist: Thank you! Budi: Be careful when you walk into the station. It's very crowded.
read.title: Turn at the Corner
